name: Russo-Turkish War and the Treaty of Küçük Kaynarca (1768–1774) (C0032)

techniques.comment: The signing of the Treaty of Küçük Kaynarca: the diplomatic severing of Crimea from the Ottoman Empire through fictitious "independence" – "neither the Russian court nor the Ottoman Porte shall interfere in the election and elevation of the said khan, nor in their domestic, political, civil, and internal affairs under any pretext"(Citation: Кючук-Кайнарджийский мирный договор 1774) – in preparation for the subsequent annexation.

The use of Ukrainian Cossack regiments in the imperial war against the Ottoman Empire. The merits of the Zaporozhians and their kish otaman Kalnyshevsky in this war "were recognized by the tsarist government and the empress, who awarded him a gold medal with diamonds"(Citation: Енциклопедія історії України: Т. 4 2007) – which saved neither him nor the Sich from reprisal right after the victory.
